subject: API Rate Limiting — Stripe Webhook Conflict
body:
Hi Priya,

I've hit a significant issue with the Stripe integration. Our current API rate limiter (implemented in PR #47 — branch feature/api-rate-limiting) aggressively throttles incoming webhook events from Stripe when payment volumes are high.

During load testing, Stripe's retry mechanism fires 3–5 times per failed webhook, which pushes us well over our 100 req/min per-IP limit. Because Stripe uses a small range of IPs, they hit the throttle consistently.

Proposed fix:
1. Whitelist Stripe's published IP ranges in the rate limiter.
2. Alternatively, create a dedicated /webhooks endpoint that bypasses rate limiting entirely with HMAC signature verification instead.

I prefer option 2 for security. I've documented both approaches in the API Rate Limiting doc (docs/api-rate-limiting.md).

Ticket NEX-231 tracks this. I need a decision from you before I can proceed so I can unblock the Payments sprint.

Thanks,
Arjun Mehta
Senior Backend Engineer
